items.label: Honeywell Q2 FY2026 (07-23-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CEO Vimal Kapur on data centers: the data-center build-out h

set.signal: CEO Vimal Kapur on data centers: the data-center build-out has grown beyond the U.S. across Europe and Asia; more data centers are putting in on-site power generation, letting Process Automation automate the utilities, energy storage and incoming gas for those power plants (multiple proposals, none yet in orders); Building Automation benefits from fire detection, security and building management systems; and sensing for liquid cooling is an emerging longer-term opportunity - 'Our sensors are required as a critical input for liquid cooling. All those OEs are actively working with us'. On Honeywell's data-center play: 'from almost, I think three, four years back to that's 5% of the Building Automation business' (the transcript does not state the starting level), and he expects a higher number across Honeywell over time.
set.figure: data centers 5% of the Building Automation business now

items.reason: The call says data centers went from almost nothing three or four years back to 5% of Building Automation now; the entry read it as 5% three or four years back. CFO Mike Stepniak confirmed on 08-11-2026: about 5% now, close to zero three, four years ago. V1 (verifier): wording kept to the call's own words; 'close to zero' is the CFO's 08-11-2026 conference statement and belongs under that label, not the call label.
items.evidence: Call l.135: 'from almost, I think three, four years back to that's 5% of the Building Automation business'; CFO 08-11: 'About three, four years ago, it was close to zero.'
